verdict.rationale: A discrete graphics card is hardware, so a data-use or training opt-out is a category error for this kind of product: there is no vendor data-collection service whose training use could be controlled. The ROCm docs call a Radeon setup a "private machine learning workstation" and a "secure" alternative to the cloud. That describes local compute a user could arrange, not a training opt-out the product ships, so the axis does not apply.
